source: Del Valle et al. 2019 BMC Plant Biology 19:496, Table 1 and Results, DOI 10.1186/s12870-019-2082-6
interpretation: PAL and WAL both lose petal anthocyanin, but PAL retains anthocyanin in photosynthetic calyx/stem tissues while WAL does not.
Flavone production remains broadly present in both white phenotypes.
This establishes the tissue boundary used by the PAL-versus-WAL persistence comparison.
hard_nonclaims: published-table transcription, not an independent remeasurement
does not by itself establish that photosynthetic-tissue anthocyanin retention causes PAL persistence
